usage: 妹妹 (mui4 mui2) is a noun used to refer to a younger sister in a family.
When talking about your sibling order, 妹妹 always refers to a sister younger than yourself.
You can use 妹妹 as the subject or object in a sentence, for Example:  「我有一個妹妹」 meaning I have a younger sister.
In casual speech, 妹妹 can be shortened to 妹, but 妹妹 is more common and clear.
You can also use 妹妹 with possessive particles like 我嘅妹妹 (my younger sister).
